snippet.title: It's Dark Inside - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141000/Its_Dark_Inside/

It's Dark inside is a turn-and-tile-based, Horror Adventure where you play as a Mother setting out to save her child by killing a horrific God from the inside. Carefully plan out your every move in this game, for every action will be met with wrath from the creatures that lurk inside.
